title: MISO, SPP Say JTIQ Portfolio ‘Fully Subscribed’

meta.summary:
MISO and SPP say their mutual transmission planning initiative to relieve congestion and connect new generation projects along their seam — the Joint Targeted Interconnection Queue — has been fully subscribed.

title: Lukewarm Stakeholder Support for NYISO Large Load Interconnection Framework

meta.summary:
NYISO’s proposed framework to comply with FERC’s Order to Show Cause on large load interconnections does not have the full endorsement of stakeholders, with most abstaining from votes recommending its approval and some state agencies in opposition. 
 The post  Lukewarm Stakeholder Support for NYISO Large Load Interconnection Framework  appeared first on  RTO Insider .

title: Majority of New Projects in ISO-NE Transitional Cluster have Withdrawn

meta.summary:
Facing interconnection cost estimates averaging over $100 million, most new projects and the majority of new capacity participating in ISO-NE’s Transitional Cluster Study have withdrawn from the RTO’s interconnection queue. 
 The post  Majority of New Projects in ISO-NE Transitional Cluster have Withdrawn  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
